newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - West Covina, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government
Code Section 53692, that the City of West Covina,
principal amount of its 1997 Refunding Certificates of
Participation, at public sale. Sealed bids will be received
at 10:00 A.M. Pacific Time, at the offices of Bowne of
California, 343 Sansome Street, 15th Floor, San Francisco,
be rejected on April 15, the City intends to again accept
bids on each successive Tuesday thereafter at 10:00 A.M.
Pacific Time at the location set forth above. The Official
Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement
